heroHeadline: Day 585: Yaqui Land Restitution Decree Signed in San Ignacio Río Muerto; Hermosillo Hospital Inaugurated; Navojoa Canal Delivered — Sonora Tour Day 2
heroSubtitle: On May 9, 2026, President Sheinbaum completed the second day of her three-day Sonora working tour. She inaugurated Hospital General de Zona No. 15 'Dr. Ernesto Ramos Bours' in Hermosillo (9:15 AM), then traveled to San Ignacio Río Muerto in the Yaqui River valley where she signed the Land Restitution Decree for the Yaqui People (Plan de Justicia del Pueblo Yaqui), returning ancestral lands and water rights to the indigenous Yaqui community, and inaugurated a school dining hall at Miguel Jaime Buitimea Elementary School. In the afternoon, she delivered the first stage of the Navojoa Main Canal (Canal de las Pilas) and provided agricultural water concession titles to producers in Navojoa — addressing food security and water access in southern Sonora's farming heartland. The tour continues May 10 in Ciudad Obregón. The sovereignty crisis backdrop remains acute: the Trump administration's review of all 53 Mexican consulates in the U.S. continues; the CIA-Chihuahua unauthorized drug operation probe is active at the FGR; Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya is on 30-day leave under National Guard protection; the USMCA first formal negotiating round is set for the week of May 25; and Banxico is widely expected to cut its rate 25bp to 6.50% at its May 14 meeting.
